forces: Two governance-core operating documents disagree with the documentation they point at, so an agent obeying either one is misdirected about where execution state lives.
Both documents are gitignored and have never been tracked, so correcting them in place improves one workstation and reaches no other machine, clone, or agent runtime.
Hermes Kanban is the canonical tracker but has no label facility, so the five canonical triage roles cannot be expressed as label strings there at all.
Four of the five canonical triage labels are absent from the repository label set, so the existing mapping is unactionable on the GitHub intake surface as well.
The two waiting triage roles both resolve to the blocked status, so any mapping that omits the block kind collapses them into one indistinguishable state.
Tracking a document makes every claim in it normative, so a factual error that was tolerable in a local file becomes a repository defect at the moment it is committed.
Operating documents that narrate an unenforced repository-state claim contradict the governance requirement that such claims cite an enforcing gate instead.

security_justification.audit_integrity: Tracking the two operating documents strengthens auditability: their contents and every future revision enter reviewable history instead of living only on one workstation. Removing a narrated repository-state claim that no gate enforces brings them into line with change-governance rather than altering any requirement.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication mechanism, identity input, privilege decision, or authorization grant is added or changed. Correcting the branch-protection paragraph documents the absence of an approval gate; it does not create, remove, or alter one.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No value gains or loses authority. The branded context registry, the operation handle registry, and every server-authoritative construction path are untouched, and documentation cannot create authority for a claim.
security_justification.concurrency: No concurrent execution, shared mutable state, or ordering behavior is introduced. Markdown files and an ignore rule are inert at build and test time and participate in no runtime path.
security_justification.confidentiality: Both newly tracked documents were scanned for credentials, tokens, and absolute local paths before publication and contain none. The only identifiers recorded are a public repository name, a public board name, and CLI-printed status and block-kind names.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic primitive, signature scheme, hashing policy, key material, or trust assumption is introduced or modified. The change adds no code path of any kind.
security_justification.error_disclosure: No error message, diagnostic, or failure path changes. The SDK still returns bounded errors carrying only a code, category, and path, and no new text reaches any caller.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No transport, exporter, collector, queue, SIEM connection, browser telemetry, or external service call is added. The authorization boundary is untouched and test:scope continues to enforce it unchanged.
security_justification.fail_posture: No gate, check, or validation changes its failure posture. Bringing two previously ignored paths into the tree widens what the governance perimeter inspects, and both are already classified as governance core, so classification still resolves and still fails closed.
security_justification.lifecycle: No lifecycle state machine, activation transition, or commit-state rule is modified. The SDK ready, shutting_down, and shut_down states and the operation handle transitions are entirely outside the changed paths.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: The change owns the ignore rule, the two operating documents, the triage mapping, and its own change directory, all declared in owned_paths. It mutates no shared artifact, no generated output, and no file owned by another active change.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No personal, client, device, browser, or real-user information is read, transformed, retained, or emitted. The change processes no data at all; it revises static prose and one ignore rule.
security_justification.resource_retention: No cache, queue, buffer, file handle, background process, or retained resource is created. The change adds no allocation and no runtime behavior whatsoever.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry, delivery, redelivery, or backoff behavior exists in the changed paths. Documenting a transient block kind describes an existing Hermes CLI facility and creates no delivery semantics in this repository.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Instructions two agent runtimes already obey locally become repository-normative and therefore reviewable, which narrows rather than widens the unreviewed surface. No parser, checker, or runtime treats these documents as data, and the SDK's trusted input set is unchanged.
